load_bridge_model: load a MOVA dual tower bridge model from a diffusers safetensors path with FSDP support
resolve_model_class: resolve a model class from a diffusers _class_name using the ModelRegistry
list_safetensors_files: list all safetensors weight files in a component model directory
get_diffusers_config: get a diffusers component config from a model path for bridge loading
load_fsdp_bridge: load a bridge model with FSDP sharding using hsdp_replicate_dim and hsdp_shard_dim
